instruction: Candid family photograph, full shot. In an outdoor yard, a man in a dark striped polo shirt and black pants (R2) on the right holds hands with a young girl in a pink dress (R1) on the left. The man (R2) leans forward, guiding the young girl (R1) as they step together on the dirt ground. A large red bougainvillea bush and a wooden fence fill the background under warm, natural daylight.
